baseline_models.focus_anchor: The emphatic construction إِنَّ عَلَيْنَا لَلْهُدَىٰ places the nominal هُدَىٰ under عَلَيْنَا rather than merely announcing that guidance exists.
baseline_models.mechanism: The guidance branch supplies gentle indication, clarification, and enabling toward a way or truth; the syntax presents that orienting work as an emphatically assumed responsibility.

activation_trace.role: Gentle indication and enabling toward a true way supplies the clause's core orienting action and makes عَلَيْنَا sound responsibility-bearing.

changed_reading.before: Guidance is simply said to belong to the speaker.
changed_reading.after: The speaker emphatically assumes responsibility for making a truth-directed way discernible and traversable.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The definite nominal لَلْهُدَىٰ can anchor not only an act of telling but the course, bearing, or intended direction carried by ه د ي.
baseline_models.mechanism: If هُدَىٰ profiles a course and manner of proceeding, the clause concerns governance of trajectory: what is 'upon us' is the directional shape of the movement, not merely delivery of a map.

activation_trace.role: The course, manner, and intended-direction image turns guidance into the practical bearing of a journey and assigns that bearing to the clause's عَلَيْنَا.

changed_reading.before: Guidance is information that points toward a road.
changed_reading.after: Guidance is the directed course and practical bearing of travel, whose orientation the speaker undertakes.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The focus noun هُدَىٰ is visibly tied to a branch in which the guide or foremost part goes ahead.
baseline_models.mechanism: Guidance can operate from in front: an advance edge enters the route first and thereby gives following motion its line. The clause then promises precedential presence rather than rearward instruction.

activation_trace.role: The leading-front image supplies an advance presence whose going-before makes the route followable.

changed_reading.before: The traveler receives directions while remaining the first to enter the route.
changed_reading.after: What is undertaken is to go ahead as a leading edge, so the traveler follows an already opened line.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The same focus root permits هُدَىٰ to resonate with something graciously sent toward a recipient.
baseline_models.mechanism: Guidance becomes a directed transfer rather than a possession held at the source. عَلَيْنَا marks source-side commitment to dispatch the gift; it does not make the recipient a creditor.

activation_trace.role: The graciously sent gift supplies a source-to-recipient trajectory and recasts guidance as beneficent transmission.

changed_reading.before: Guidance is a stock of knowledge located with the speaker.
changed_reading.after: Guidance is a gracious dispatch whose movement toward the addressee is undertaken at the source.

context_deltas.mechanism: Covering, daylight's opening, and disclosure make guidance temporally textured. Direction can remain real while visibility is occluded, then become manifest at the fitting phase; guidance is continuity across changing access, not uninterrupted glare.

activation_trace.role: Gentle clarification anchors the model in guidance while allowing disclosure to be paced rather than maximal at every moment.
A cover rising over and concealing something supplies the phase in which the route persists without full visibility.
Daylight opening into illumination supplies expanded perceptual access to the route.
Uncovering and manifestation turn the second phase into active disclosure rather than mere chronological daylight.

structural_cues: The paired oath scenes of 92:1-2 repeat إِذَا while reversing cover into disclosure.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies alternating concealment and manifestation; I infer that guidance can preserve direction through occlusion and time disclosure, while a live alternative is that the pair only contrasts cosmic scenes.

changed_reading.before: If guidance is being supplied, the whole way should remain continuously visible.
changed_reading.after: Guidance can hold a stable direction through periods of cover and disclose the way in phases.

context_deltas.mechanism: Measured creation, purposeful movement, and dispersed outcomes recast guidance as calibration across heterogeneous trajectories. One orienting responsibility need not flatten the created differences among those moving.

activation_trace.role: Course and intended direction anchor guidance as trajectory-management rather than a uniform verbal message.
Measuring and proportioning a thing supplies differentiation by design rather than accidental variation.
Purposeful motion toward an object makes the surrounding diversity a set of directed trajectories.
Dispersion supplies the real divergence that an orienting mechanism must address without erasing.

structural_cues: The created male-female pair in 92:3 is followed by the plural addressees' divergent striving in 92:4.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies measured creation and purposeful yet scattered movement; I infer that guidance is fitted orientation across difference, while the alternative is a simpler moral contrast with no individualized calibration.

changed_reading.before: Guidance is one undifferentiated instruction applied identically to everyone.
changed_reading.after: Guidance is a common orienting responsibility capable of addressing differently constituted and diverging strivings.

context_deltas.mechanism: Giving, self-placement within protection, and enacted verification are followed by an opening after difficulty and tractable movement. Guidance therefore includes responsive enabling: a practiced orientation becomes increasingly traversable.

activation_trace.role: Guidance as indication plus divine enabling anchors the shift from communicated direction to assisted traversal.
Handing something over supplies an outward practice that begins to embody the chosen direction.
Placing oneself within protection supplies deliberate self-positioning, not passive receipt.
Making a promise or claim true in action supplies verification that stabilizes the orientation.
Opening into ease after difficulty supplies the path-level response to the enacted disposition.
Light, compliant motion makes enabling bodily and kinetic: movement increasingly follows the chosen line.

structural_cues: The فَأَمَّا sequence of 92:5-7 places three dispositions before the future easing response.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an ordered practice-to-easing sequence; I read it as a feedback arrow within guidance, while the alternative is that easing is a later reward adjacent to, but not constitutive of, guidance.

changed_reading.before: Guidance ends once a correct direction has been stated.
changed_reading.after: Guidance can answer enacted orientation by opening the route and making continued movement along it more tractable.

context_deltas.mechanism: Withholding, claimed sufficiency, and rejection establish an opposed orientation; easing then means reduced resistance along that chosen line, even as the line bends into hardship and finally a fall. Guidance discloses a bifurcating field without coercively preventing every destructive course.

activation_trace.role: Course and intended direction anchor the model in the focus word as trajectory rather than guaranteed arrival.
Withholding supplies the first embodied commitment of the opposed course.
The image of self-sufficing adequacy closes the actor against dependence on further orientation.
Assigning falsity to the thing or its bearer makes rejection an active directional judgment.
Tractable motion explains how an adverse course can become easy to continue without becoming good.
Crooked resistance and complication supply the destination produced by the apparently easy continuation.
Falling into ruin supplies the terminal geometry of the self-reinforcing adverse trajectory.

structural_cues: The mirrored frames of 92:5-7 and 92:8-10 use the same easing verb for opposed destinations.
The fall of 92:11 stands immediately before the focus claim of 92:12.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies opposed dispositions, repeated easing, hardship, and fall; I infer path-dependence in which motion becomes easier along a chosen orientation, while the alternative is that the two easings are purely external assignments.

changed_reading.before: Divine guidance must force every addressed person away from ruin.
changed_reading.after: Guidance can truthfully expose the fork and its ends while chosen dispositions become self-reinforcing trajectories, including a frictionless approach to a hard fall.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately following claim spans beginning, later end, return, and even administration. It grounds the responsibility for direction in command of the whole temporal arc: guidance can orient from origin through outcome rather than intervene at one isolated point.

activation_trace.role: The intended course anchors guidance as an arc whose beginning and outcome can be jointly governed.
Laterness after a first point supplies the far end of the temporal span.
Beginning and precedence supply the near end from which the guided course opens.
Return to final outcome folds destination back into the first/latter pair and makes direction teleological.
The non-dominant mapped image of administering an affair adds stewardship to temporal possession.

structural_cues: 92:12 and 92:13 form adjacent emphatic claims: إِنَّ عَلَيْنَا followed by وَإِنَّ لَنَا.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies responsibility for direction beside possession of first and latter, plus a mapped administration image; I infer whole-course stewardship, while the alternative keeps the two claims independent.

changed_reading.before: Guidance is a punctual message inserted somewhere within a person's life.
changed_reading.after: Guidance is stewardship of orientation across the full arc from beginning through return and outcome.

context_deltas.mechanism: Warning awakens caution, fire can be perceived from afar as a visible marker, and pure flame fixes the boundary's consequence. The gentle way-showing of the focus can therefore include an alarming advance disclosure; severity of signal need not cancel beneficence of function.

activation_trace.role: Gentle indication toward truth anchors warning as a way-showing function rather than an independent threat theme.
The split-root threatening image pressure-tests the tonal range of guidance and activates its severe warning register.
A warning that frightens in order to awaken caution supplies the preventive purpose of the severe signal.
Fire sighted from a distance makes the danger an advance landmark rather than only a later punishment.
Pure, fiercely kindled flame supplies the real boundary condition that gives the warning urgency.

structural_cues: The first explicit speech-act after the paired claims of 92:12-13 is the first-person warning in 92:14.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies caution-awakening warning, distant visibility, and flame; I infer that advance warning is one mode of discharging guidance, while the alternative treats warning and guidance as neighboring but categorically separate acts.

changed_reading.before: Guidance must sound soothing, so a frightening warning lies outside it.
changed_reading.after: Guidance may remain gentle in aim while using an unmistakably severe advance signal to expose where a course ends.

context_deltas.mechanism: Turning the face, turning away, being led laterally, and being protected turn abstract direction into bodily orientation. Rejection is an enacted reversal of facing; rescue is a guided displacement to the safe side of danger.

activation_trace.role: Intended direction anchors the bodily turn and lateral displacement as concrete operations of guidance.
Turning the face toward something supplies the positive bodily geometry of orientation.
Turning one's back and withdrawing supplies the same geometry reversed by refusal.
Leading something to the side supplies active rerouting away from the dangerous line.
Repelling harm through protection gives the lateral rerouting its preservative function.

structural_cues: The active turning-away of 92:16 is answered by the passive being-kept-aside of 92:17.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies opposed turning and protective side-placement; I infer a shared spatial mechanism of orientation, while the alternative reads the verbs as unrelated rejection and reward.

changed_reading.before: Guidance is an inward belief or verbal instruction with no spatial operation.
changed_reading.after: Guidance can be a bodily reorientation: facing, refusing to face, or being led onto the safe side of a danger.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus gift-image is activated by wealth being given, growth or purification, denial of a compensable prior favor, and desire directed toward a face. Guidance is a non-transactional transmission that redirects its recipient into further giving rather than closing a debt ledger.

activation_trace.role: A gracious gift sent toward someone supplies the incoming transfer whose effects can continue through the recipient.
Giving rather than merely arriving makes the recipient's answering movement an intentional outgoing transfer.
Possessed and accumulated wealth supplies the material that is released rather than retained.
Growth and increase make giving generative rather than a simple subtraction from a fixed stock.
Matching an act with recompense supplies the transactional logic that the surrounding negation suspends.
Seeking makes the gift's downstream movement purposive rather than socially repayable.
Direction and orientation give the seeking a non-human endpoint and turn generosity into reorientation.

structural_cues: 92:18-20 moves from giving wealth, through the negation of a repayable favor, to an exclusive sought end.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies gift, outgoing wealth, growth, suspended recompense, and directed seeking; I infer a circulating but non-exchange economy of guidance, while the alternative limits these verses to the giver's conduct after an independently received guidance.

changed_reading.before: Because guidance is 'upon us,' it resembles a debt discharged once information is handed over.
changed_reading.after: Guidance is an unpriced gift that reorients reception into generative giving without creating a human repayment claim.

context_deltas.mechanism: Seeking a face, lordly cultivation toward completion, ascent, and eventual satisfaction make guidance developmental and relational. The directed course is not exhausted by compliance; it matures a seeker toward an elevated encounter and acceptance.

activation_trace.role: Course, bearing, and intended direction anchor the model in a sustained trajectory toward an end.
Active seeking supplies the traveler's desire-driven participation in the course.
The face as what fronts and receives approach gives guidance a relationally encountered terminus.
Cultivating, repairing, and bringing to completion supplies the developmental work performed along the route.
Elevation supplies the vertical transformation of the directed and cultivated seeker.
Mutual satisfaction supplies a relational completion more reciprocal than bare arrival.

structural_cues: The exclusive seeking of 92:20 flows directly into the open-ended future satisfaction of 92:21.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies seeking, facing, cultivation, elevation, and satisfaction; I infer a developmental relation culminating in acceptance, while the alternative treats satisfaction as reward after, rather than the telos internal to, guidance.

changed_reading.before: Guidance is an external rule whose endpoint is correct compliance.
changed_reading.after: Guidance is a cultivated, desire-engaging course whose horizon is elevated relational satisfaction.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The bodily scene is surprising because هُدَىٰ is usually abstract, but it is directly anchored in a focus-root branch and coheres with ease of motion and the nearby fall. Render it as an embodied analogy for enabling, not as a claim that the focus noun literally denotes assisted walking here.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: A focus-root branch pictures a weak or swaying walker moving by leaning on companions.

activation_trace.role: Supported, swaying walking turns guidance into accompaniment that bears some of the traveler's weight.
Light and compliant movement supplies the bodily effect of successful support.
The fall into ruin supplies the kinetic danger against which supportive guidance matters.

changed_reading.before: Guidance points while the traveler carries the entire burden of movement.
changed_reading.after: Guidance may accompany and partially bear an unstable traveler until movement becomes easier and a fall can be avoided.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is form-distant because it activates a rare nominal branch for a protected person or captive, yet the exact focus root and the later protection and side-leading cues keep it anchored. Render it as a temporary custodial profile of عَلَيْنَا, not as the lexical replacement of 'guidance.'
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus-root inventory includes a person under inviolability, pledge, protection, or captivity within the semantic field of ه د ي.

activation_trace.role: The protected person or captive shifts the object under responsibility from guidance-content to a vulnerable traveler held in custody.
Leading something to the side supplies the custodian's concrete act of removing the vulnerable subject from danger.
Protection that repels harm supplies the purpose of the custodial obligation.

changed_reading.before: What lies 'upon us' is only the delivery of correct content.
changed_reading.after: For a moment the clause profiles custodial responsibility for the protected traveler whom guidance must lead out of harm's line.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The offering sense is morphologically and contextually more distant than ordinary هُدَىٰ, but it belongs to the exact focus-root inventory and is reactivated by wealth transfer and exclusive seeking of the Lord's face. Render it as a devotional trajectory latent in the root, never as a claim that the verse straightforwardly says 'offering.'
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus root carries a branch for an offering sent toward a sanctuary.

activation_trace.role: An offering dispatched toward a sacred center supplies a devotional direction in which transfer itself traces the route.
Giving supplies the concrete act by which possessed material is sent away from the giver.
Accumulated wealth supplies the material capable of becoming a devoted transfer.
Seeking supplies the intention that directs the transfer beyond ordinary exchange.
The face standing for the self supplies the personal divine terminus of the devotional dispatch.
Lordship and sovereignty identify the sacred relation toward which the offering-image is oriented.

changed_reading.before: Guidance and giving are separate: one indicates while the other transfers wealth.
changed_reading.after: The root briefly lets guidance resemble a devotional offering whose directed transfer toward the sacred center is itself a way.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The bridal branch is socially specific and should not be promoted into a marriage interpretation of 92:12. It remains worth carrying because it is directly attached to the focus root and the context supplies paired sexes, facing, and relational satisfaction; render it only as an escorted-transition analogy.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: A focus-root branch depicts a bride being led into a new relational station rather than finding the route alone.

activation_trace.role: The bride being led supplies an escorted passage from one social state into a new bond.
The male member of the created pair supplies the relational polarity that makes the transition image legible.
The female member of the created pair keeps the branch activation tied to the packet's own paired social imagery.
Face-to-face encounter supplies the relational arrival toward which escorted transition can move.
Mutual satisfaction supplies a relationally completed state rather than mere arrival at a location.

changed_reading.before: Guidance is solitary navigation by an informed individual.
changed_reading.after: Guidance can be imagined as an escorted transition into a transformed relation, with the guide responsible for the passage.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is the strangest activation because it depends on the packet's non-dominant ه د د mapping rather than the dominant guidance root. It remains anchored by the exact focus occurrence and converges with the packet's hardship, fall, and warning sequence. Render it explicitly as a split-root pressure reading, not as ordinary lexical semantics.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The packet maps the focus occurrence secondarily to ه د د, whose branches include structural collapse, a hard descent, and threat.

activation_trace.role: Severe breaking and collapse make guidance load-bearing: it must reveal or dismantle the support whose failure would ruin the traveler.
A difficult descent gives the guided way a hazardous gradient rather than a neutral surface.
Falling into ruin activates the split-root descent and collapse images immediately before the focus claim.
Caution-awakening warning supplies the preventive response to a route whose structure can fail.

changed_reading.before: Guidance marks a route laid across stable ground.
changed_reading.after: The split root briefly recasts guidance as responsibility to expose a treacherous descent and the collapse hidden in its load-bearing structure.

strongest_changes: Guidance shifted from message-delivery to responsibility for the course, including disclosure, advance presence, and enabling.
The mirrored easing sequences made guidance compatible with path-dependence: practiced orientations become increasingly traversable even when one ends in hardship.
The first-and-latter claim expanded guidance into stewardship of an entire temporal arc.
Giving, suspended recompense, and directed seeking activated guidance as a non-transactional gift that generates further giving.
Warning, bodily turning, side-leading, and fall made guidance spatial and preventive rather than purely propositional.
summary.what_was_special: The focus root supported several simultaneous geometries—way, leading front, dispatched gift, supported gait, protected traveler, escorted passage, and sacred offering—while its non-dominant ه د د mapping introduced a contained counter-image of threat, difficult descent, and collapse. Context did not collapse these into one sense; it made different mechanisms flare at different points.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether عَلَيْنَا is best heard as self-assumed obligation, guaranteed provision, or sovereign prerogative remains grammatically open.
It is uncertain whether easing toward hardship belongs inside the mechanism of guidance or names a neighboring consequence after guidance is refused.
The bodily, custodial, bridal, and offering branches may be productive analogies without carrying direct lexical force in this nominal form.
The non-dominant ه د د activation is packet-grounded but too mapping-distant to use without explicit containment.
